Same sheet number as Medusa, the turtles and the other sheet-176 decks: only deck.identity tells them apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Bands (fighter restrictions) read from the images: ACHILLES on Achilles' Heel, Under Achilles' Helm and Spear Throw; PATROCLUS on Battle Frenzy and The Day of Your Doom; ANY on the other seven titles. Restrictions are not in unmatched-memory. Titles, copies (30 in all), type, value, boost and texts of the 12 titles match unmatched-memory.

Hero card (read from unmatched-memory): ACHILLES, MELEE, START HEALTH 18, MOVE 2; sidekick PATROCLUS, MELEE, START HEALTH 6, MOVE 2. One Patroclus, a Custom_Token in the save (like Daisy and The Porter) with his own sidekick health dial.

Passive `vengeance` (sparring/vengeance.py): +2 to every attack of Achilles himself while Patroclus is defeated; the trigger (2 random discards) and the draw are DSL (data/heroes/effects/achilles.json).
